brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 straight irrigation run entryEdge 3 at 0,0 through q1,0 q2,0 q3,0 – passes through all 4 cells' bases; bins are hex-bin-third which is allowed in pipe-through cells

finish.summary: 4-cell linear planter (0,0 to 3,0) with continuous pipe run through every base, third-depth bins in each cell, soil and plants, capped and joint-locked. Verified meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text:
Four-cell planter with continuous water feed built as a linear 4-base run: bases at 0,0 1,0 2,0 3,0, straight irrigation pipe (run:run-1) passes through all four bases from entryEdge 3 on 0,0 through 1,0 2,0 to 3,0, and one third-depth planter bin in each cell (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third etc.) compatible with straight pipe-through cell. Soil filled and planted in all four bins, caps and joint bolts applied, meshClash clear.

Built modestly under 40 parts (30 parts, 1880g).

Verification: `get_build` shows 4 piece full, 1 run, 4 bins; final `check_build` ok true meshClash clear; `look` sees plants in all four bins.
